scope: Actual Codex in-app Chromium at 390x844 navigated all 84 selected case routes after the task-owned HTTP origin server on 127.0.0.1:8096 was stopped and a direct no-proxy origin request failed. Public initialized investigation projections rendered from the previously cached application. This is origin-server-unavailable startup/recovery coverage, not an OS/browser network-toggle test, full offline solving, or cross-engine coverage.
verificationMethod: Read-only audit of the executor's current-run browser observations, pre-navigation origin probe and 84 public DOM transcripts; recomputed every referenced file SHA-256, checked exact selected-manifest coverage and visible initialized case projections, verified all observation timestamps follow the origin probe, and recomputed current source/profile/build identity through tools/lib/v212-evidence.ts loadRun. This audit did not run a new browser test, inspect browser storage, or substitute a Node/live-Service-Worker simulation for the recorded browser run.

publicDomCriteria.caseMarker: THE BLACK SOUP · Cnn must match the case ID.
publicDomCriteria.heading: A level-one case heading must be present.
publicDomCriteria.navigation: Investigation navigation and the four public controls 现场 / 提问 / 证据 / 推断 must be present.
publicDomCriteria.initializedProjection: A scene inspection heading 可以检查 or an actual recovered public investigation projection must be present; a shell alone is insufficient. Here 83 cases show scene inspection; C01 shows the selected question workspace, heading 你想先确认什么？, question textbox, two recorded factual answers and the undo control.
publicDomCriteria.loadingOrErrorPage: No observed 正在加载 / 加载案件 / 初始化失败 / 加载失败 / 发生错误 / Application error / This site cannot be reached / ERR_CONNECTION|INTERNET|NETWORK|CACHE marker.
publicDomCriteria.emptyAlert: The empty '- alert' accessibility node in the snapshots is not treated as an error message.

sourceIdentityVerification.implementation: tools/lib/v212-evidence.ts loadRun/evidenceIdentity/currentSource; reports and output artifacts are excluded by that existing implementation.

originAvailability.failureMode: Task-owned local HTTP server stopped; global OS networking was not disabled.
originAvailability.preNavigationAction: Executor verified the exact task-owned Python http.server 8096 process command line serving turtle-soup/apps/web/out, stopped only that process and then recorded the direct no-proxy connection-refusal probe before the 84 browser navigation checks.

retainedProbe.timing: Before all 84 recorded case observations; not a continuous packet capture.

originAvailability.observationTiming: Per-case 'at' values in the original observations are preserved as observedAt. They are not relabeled as navigation start/end timings.

recoveryObservation.currentRunProjection: Selected question workspace restored with a question textbox, two factual-answer history entries and the undo control visible.
recoveryObservation.claimBoundary: This is an observed recovered question-history state, not proof that those questions were submitted or evaluated while the origin was unavailable. C61 in this run shows scene startup, not a solved-case recovery. No earlier-run evidence is imported or relabeled.

limitations: One browser engine and one 390x844 viewport only; Firefox, WebKit, other viewport widths and physical-device behavior were not tested by this evidence.

Origin HTTP server unavailability is the measured failure mode; OS networking, browser network emulation, third-party connectivity and offline fetch behavior for unrelated origins were not toggled or established.

The application had been cached before this run. This does not demonstrate first installation without a network, exhaustive cache contents, every interaction or asset, all-case completion, or every save/recovery state.
The retained probe establishes the unavailable origin before the recorded observations, not uninterrupted network monitoring throughout the entire sequence.
DOM transcripts establish visible initialized projections, not internal Worker or cache state. Browser storage was not inspected during this report verification.
The empty consoleErrors array is the executor's recorded result, not a claim that every background network event was captured.
